entry.title: New: dsh-deepseek-vision
entry.summary: Reuses DeepSeek web's built-in vision mode for text-only models: the deepseek_vision tool drives the local deepseek-vision-cli browser automation (manual login helper, deep-think enabled, auto-closes browser) and returns image descriptions as text. Exact install spec: github:cheng-cheng9669/dsh-deepseek-vision. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
